title: マイルCSの後に・満身創痍のミラクル

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I beat Taiki in a mile race! I passed my test! I'm going abroad next year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What?! Taiki's going abroad too?! And she wants to race against me overseas?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, that backfired! Next up is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen! After a race on my best distance, I'm off to take on the world!
